transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?
Ever since they cut my hours and dumped all this paperwork on me, I just haven’t been handling it well. I feel like I’m reacting all wrong to everything at work.

Did these feelings start after your work hours were cut and the extra paperwork began, or were you already feeling down or worried most days before that? Also, are the feelings mainly tied to work stress, or do they continue even when you’re away from work?

Yeah, this all definitely kicked in a week or two after they cut my hours and dumped the paperwork on me, and I was doing fine before that. It’s definitely spilled over into my personal life now too—I’ve been skipping my rec league games and turning down side jobs with my buddies because I’m just too wound up and embarrassed to face anyone.

Since this started, have you mostly been feeling sad or unable to enjoy things, or is it more that you feel constantly worried and on edge? Has the worry spread to lots of areas of life besides the work situation?

It's really a mix of both—I feel constantly wound up and on edge, to the point where I'm on the verge of snapping or tearing up over little things. While the stress definitely started with the work changes, it has spilled over into my social life and routine because I'm just too overwhelmed and embarrassed to do things I normally enjoy, like my rec league.

Since this started, have you been feeling down or unable to enjoy things most of the day nearly every day, even when you’re not thinking about work? Or does it mainly feel like distress that flares up around the work situation and its fallout?

It’s definitely tied to the work situation and all the fallout from it. I don't think I'm just down for no reason, but I'm so wound up and embarrassed about how I'm failing at these new work tasks that it's made me pull away from my rec league and side jobs.

Since this started, has it caused problems in how you function day to day—like your work performance, sleep, relationships, or taking care of responsibilities? If so, what areas have been affected the most?

Yes, it’s definitely messed up my daily life. My work performance slipped so much that my foreman actually gave me a written warning. On top of that, I’ve stopped going to my rec league games and turned down weekend side jobs with my buddies, which has really hurt my social life and my extra income.

Since this started, have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living or that you might hurt yourself? Also, have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks, even apart from the work stress?

No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or that life isn't worth living. And I don't feel depressed all the time on my own; these overwhelmed feelings are strictly tied to the work situation and everything going on there.
How long has this reaction to the work changes been going on now? Has it been less than 6 months, or has it continued longer than that?
It’s been going on for about a month now, so it’s definitely been less than six months. It all started a week or two after they cut my hours and changed my duties.

final_diagnosis.reason: Symptoms began within weeks of an identifiable psychosocial stressor at work, are clearly tied to that stressor, include both anxiety and depressed mood, cause functional impairment in work and social domains, and have lasted about one month. The presentation does not meet criteria for a major depressive episode or another primary mood/anxiety disorder independent of the stressor.
